holder-quote: Vetn leapt. Merish saw a blur as his axe dropped through the air. He saw Viri tear free of the paws holding him and leap, bellowing.
effect-quote: Forty feet away, Vetn reappeared. His cargo was under one arm, eyes wide, disbelieving. The Gnoll turned. Only Tesy understood what he’d done.

holder-quote: In his last ten feet to Klbkch’s back, the Thief of Clouds vanished.
